description: Retrieve latest euro-area observations from fixed ECB macroeconomic series; optional region U2 and mode latest only. Returns current and previous values, units, observation dates, status flags and percentage-point changes where applicable. Provisional observations remain labeled and revisions are possible. Single institutional-source snapshot: no revision vintages, no cross-provider verification. Source: ECB, free of charge at ecb.europa.eu; derived by SYNTHORA; not for transactions. [x402: 0.03 USDC per call on Base]

mode.description: Compatibility field constrained to latest by the public schema. The currently routed backend ignores it and requests the last two observations of each fixed series. It provides no selectable date/history mode; latest is not a live-feed or freshness guarantee.

region.description: Compatibility field constrained to U2 by the public schema. The currently routed backend ignores this argument and requests its three fixed Euro-area (U2) ECB series; it cannot select another region.

name: ecb_macro
